description: Register the use case in the AI register with owner and purpose
Use a model from the approved model catalog
Log prompts outputs and model version for 90 days
Complete a DPIA where personal data is processed
A human reviews outputs before they affect a resident or supplier
Offline evaluation against a labelled test set with agreed acceptance threshold
Personal data must be processed in UK or EU regions only
Formal approval by the AI Steering Committee before pilot
Test outcomes across protected characteristics with documented results
Residents are told when an automated decision affects them and how to challenge it
Drift and performance monitoring with alerting and quarterly review
Documented procedure to disable the system within 1 hour
